Proportional-Odds Model for a Graded Ordinal Outcome

Source: R/call_outcomes.R
mysterycall_ordinal_model.Rd

Fits an ordinal (cumulative-link) model to a graded outcome such as an access tier, returning proportional-odds odds ratios with Wald confidence intervals and p-values. Thin wrapper around MASS::polr().

Usage

mysterycall_ordinal_model(
  data,
  outcome_var,
  predictors,
  levels = NULL,
  conf_level = 0.95
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

outcome_var

Character scalar. The ordinal outcome column.

predictors

Character vector. Predictor column names.

levels

Character vector or NULL. The outcome's increasing level order. NULL uses the existing factor ordering or sorted unique values.

conf_level

Numeric. Confidence level for the Wald intervals. Default 0.95.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with columns term, or, ci_lower, ci_upper, p_value (one row per predictor coefficient).

See also

Other call-outcomes: mysterycall_classify_call_outcome(), mysterycall_multiresponse_tabulate(), mysterycall_outcome_gradient()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  df <- data.frame(
    access = factor(sample(c("phone", "in_person", "must_establish"), 90, TRUE),
                    levels = c("phone", "in_person", "must_establish"),
                    ordered = TRUE),
    medicaid = sample(c(0, 1), 90, TRUE)
  )
  mysterycall_ordinal_model(df, "access", "medicaid")
}
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   term        or ci_lower ci_upper p_value
#>   <chr>    <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 medicaid  1.66    0.772     3.58   0.194
